content.notes: This page is a reference list emphasizing studies on high-sensitivity cardiac troponin assays (T and I), sex- and age-specific cutoff values, and validation of rapid diagnostic algorithms for myocardial infarction/acute coronary syndrome.

genes.context: Multiple references discuss high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (hs-cTnT) and sex-specific cutoff values to diagnose myocardial infarction and acute coronary syndrome (refs 74,75,77,78,80). TNNT2 encodes cardiac troponin T.
Reference 79 explicitly discusses implementing a high-sensitivity troponin I assay (hs-cTnI) and sex-specific effects in suspected acute coronary syndrome. TNNI3 encodes cardiac troponin I.
